भृत् a. bearing, maintaining, possessing, having, bringing,
procuring (—˚).

भृतक a. hired, paid;
 m. a hired servant.
भृतकाध्यापित a. taught by a hired teacher.

भृति॑ f. bearing, carrying, maintaining, nourishing;
wages or service for wages.
भृत्यभाव m. the state of a servant, servitude.

भृत्याय् भृत्या˚यते behave like a servant towards
(loc.).
